ida: quick hotpatch tonight 01:15 UTC: kernel v2.16.1-hotfix + quant qf-2026-hot. scope: fix kv write race. rollout: 0.5% -> 5% -> 30% -> 100% with 5m holds. auto-pin if 5xx >0.4% for 4m. cross-region requires lee ack.

deploybot: scheduled job=deploy-5243210000 preflight=00:45 UTC. will run prebake+smoke. /status for updates.

lee: noted. ops watch: evictions and p99. we can sticky-pin region-us for 3h if manual pin needed.

eng-sre-bot: preflight PASSED 00:47 UTC. prebake ok, smoke ok, checksum match.

deploybot: canary 0.5% started 01:15:05 UTC. metrics: https://internal.redwood/metrics/deploy-5243210000

ops: initial check p99 +1.8%, 5xx flat, kv-miss unchanged. clear to 5% after hold.

ida: if anyone sees 5xx >0.4% for 4m call manual pin: `deploybot pin set --id deploy-5243210000 --ttl 3h --scope region-us`. rollback command: `/deploy rollback deploy-5243210000 --reason "health gate breach"`

deploybot: promoted to 5% 01:21:10 UTC. holding.

ops: at 01:24 UTC one canary shard spiked 5xx briefly (0.6%) for ~90s, then dropped. I recommend holding at 5% and enabling sticky pin if it reappears.

lee: agree hold. enabling sticky pin TTL=3h for region-us now.

deploybot: sticky pin set.

ida: spike looks transient, no rollback. will keep team monitoring and post RN after 30% hold. thanks.
